Although the 10:00 AM slot was described as available, the caller repeatedly asked whether it was a confirmed booking and whether confirmation would be sent to her email. The agent could not verify or confirm the request because of a system issue and advised the caller not to consider it completed. The caller provided her name and email, asked when the visit could be scheduled and whether any pre-visit details were required, but these questions were not resolved. She acknowledged the issue, said her questions were clear, thanked the agent, and ended the call without a confirmed appointment.
